annotations.title: Bricks, blocks, mortar, concrete and plasterboard quantities

description: Works out quantities from dimensions, with the working: bricks (60 a m2 per half brick leaf), blocks (about 10 a m2), cavity walls with ties, mortar from wall volume minus unit volume, cement bags and sand tonnes for a chosen mix, concrete for strip foundations and slabs (ready mix order rounded up to 0.25 m3, or site mixed 1:2:4 materials), and plasterboard sheets by size. Openings are deducted. Waste allowances default to bricks and blocks 5%, mortar 10%, concrete 5%, plasterboard 10% and can be changed. Returns `order` (what to buy), per item `working`, totals before waste and notes. Example: a 6 m by 2.4 m cavity wall with a 1.2 m2 window, plus a 6 m strip foundation 0.6 m wide and 1 m deep: {"items":[{"kind":"cavity_wall","length_m":6,"height_m":2.4,"openings_m2":1.2},{"kind":"strip_foundation","length_m":6,"width_m":0.6,"depth_m":1}]}.

block_thickness_mm.description: Block and cavity walls. Defaults to 100.

openings_m2.description: Walls: total area of windows and doors to deduct.

mortar_mix_sand_parts.description: Sand parts to 1 cement, defaults to 5 (1:5). Use what the specification says.

trade.description: Optional. The builder's own business details (Nero Trade Profile v1). Used to prefill the contractor details in notices and CDM answers and to give a stable nero_trade_ref. Not stored by Site Pack.

company_name.description: Registered company name, if a limited company.

company_number.description: Companies House number, for example 12345678 or SC123456.

display_name.description: Trading name shown to customers, for example "Oakline Building Services".

licence_body.description: Trade body or competent person scheme the business is a member of (the one used for the reference).

licence_number.description: Membership or registration number with that body.

waste_percent.description: Override any of: bricks, blocks, mortar, concrete, plasterboard (percent).
